known_issues: RBI_Calc!G61 holds =SUM(G49:G59): the COF-2 sum stops one row before the flash point (row 60), although the flash point has a weight of 4, the weights only total 100 with it and the shell sheet adds it. The software adds it. Decided by the project owner (29 Nov 2026); to be confirmed by the client.
C2.10 'Flash Point': the weight in RBI_Calc!C60 is a link to another workbook file; the number Excel last saved there (4) is used.

Factor_Master holds other weights than RBI_Calc for 21 factors (C2.2, C2.4, C2.5, C2.7, C2.9, P1.7, P1.8, P2.1, P2.2, P2.3, P2.5, P2.6, P2.7, P2.8, P2.9, P2.10, P3.1, P3.2, P3.3, P3.4, P3.5). The weights of RBI_Calc are used (the client said Factor_Master is not filled in for this sheet).

P2.6 Wall ratio: RBI_Calc!D25 works out t_actual ÷ t_min, but its score table is headed t_min ÷ t_actual and the shell sheet takes t_min ÷ t_actual (as written, a thinner tube scores better). The software takes t_min ÷ t_actual. Decided by the project owner (29 Nov 2026); to be confirmed by the client.

Thickness override: Config!B7 is on and RBI_Calc!D99 / D100 say POF is 5 at or below t_min, but the D100 formula (=G92) leaves it out. The software sets POF to 5, as the shell sheet does. Decided by the project owner (29 Nov 2026); to be confirmed by the client.

Config: the inspection priority table has no column for POF category 5. The software uses the column of the shell sheet (COF 5 to 1: 1, 3, 5, 10, 12). Decided by the project owner (29 Nov 2026); to be confirmed by the client.
'Recommendation': 15 formulas contain #REF! (they point at a cell that no longer exists).
'RBI_Calc': 9 formulas contain #REF! (they point at a cell that no longer exists).

'DM -TUBE side' is not used by RBI_Calc: P1.8 and P2.1 are taken from 'DM -SHell'. In the software a mechanism's place (external = shell side, internal = tube side) comes from the damage-mechanism library.
